about: Object-mask classes: the id each class is drawn with in Unreal's ground-truth mask, its
colour and its group. Terrain Studio bakes these into the mask material and tags the
actors; the GNC stereo node publishes them (object_mask_mapping, object_mask_classes)
and the dashboard draws its legend from them.
The same file is in both repositories:
Edit both together; Terrain Studio's ground-truth page reports when they differ.
Colours are 8-bit and even: the lowest bit of each channel carries the shadow mask.
Ids above the last one here (custom stencils) are drawn in a colour hashed from the id.
